$description: Expense Tracker design tokens v0.1. Derived from design-system/STYLE_GUIDE.md v0.1. Format follows the Design Tokens Community Group (DTCG) specification where practical; see $extensions['com.expense-tracker.meta'] for deviations.

basisValues.style-guide: Value is stated in the Style Guide.
basisValues.proposal: Value is not stated in the Style Guide; proposed here with rationale in 'note'. Approved by the product owner on 24 October 2026 as an initial design-system default; remains a proposal until validated in usability testing or adopted into the Style Guide.

com.expense-tracker.meta.tiers: Foundation tokens (color.palette, font, space, radius, borderWidth, size, motion, opacity) hold shared raw values. Semantic tokens (color.background ... color.chart, typography, layout) give them meaning. Component tokens (component.*) bind semantics to future components. All raw colors live only in color.palette; a component token holds a raw dimension only when that value is specific to one component and not shared.

accessibilityStatus.tokenLevel: PASSED. 18 foreground/background token pairings were checked against WCAG 2.2 AA contrast (4.5:1 text, 3:1 control boundaries and graphics, 7:1 target for primary button label); all pass. Touch-target tokens are >= 48px (SG-17).
accessibilityStatus.componentLevel: UNVERIFIED. Token values alone do not prove accessible components. Rendered contrast in context, focus order, screen-reader roles and announcements (SG-41), non-color state cues (SG-42), 200% text scaling (SG-43) and reduced motion (SG-44) must be verified when components are specified and built.

deviations: font.lineHeight uses px dimensions (as written in the Style Guide) rather than unitless numbers.
Tabular numerals and uppercase transform are recorded in $extensions['com.expense-tracker.typography'] because DTCG has no token type for them.
No shadow/elevation tokens: the Style Guide identifies surfaces with borders (SG-06) and does not call for elevation.
